info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trader Position Overview API
info.description: The Trader Position Overview API provides insights into the current positions held by traders in the wholesale trading environment. This endpoint enables users to retrieve comprehensive data regarding trader positions, including their financial metrics and risk assessments. Typically used by financial analysts and trading teams, this API supports decision-making processes related to trading strategies and risk management. Accessing this information helps stakeholders monitor trader performance and optimize trading activities effectively.

get.description: Fetch the current operations related to trader positions in the wholesale trading context. This endpoint provides insights into the actions and statuses of various trader positions, enabling better management and oversight.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve trader position operations in the wholesale trading system. It allows users to specify parameters relevant to querying trader positions.

GetTraderPositionOperationsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation concerning trader position operations in wholesale trading.

sort.description: Sorting information related to the trading positions.

GetTraderPositionOperationsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Trader Position Operations GET request, containing an array of trading items, pagination info, sorting information, and metadata.

tradingBookId.description: The identifier for the trading book associated with the position.

instrumentId.description: The identifier for the instrument being traded.

side.description: The side of the trade, e.g., 'buy' or 'sell'.

quantity.description: The quantity of the instrument traded.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record, indicating if it's active, cancelled, etc.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the position was last updated.

currency.description: The currency in which the limit price is expressed.

LimitPrice.description: Represents the limit price for a trading position.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

totalItems.description: The total number of items available.

Pagination.description: Contains pagination information for the response.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier for correlating requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata information related to the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint handling the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application where the operation was executed.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication method using a Bearer token, typically a JSON Web Token (JWT), which clients must include in the Authorization header of their requests to access protected resources.
